notes.title: Equalizing prices… but sale first!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10164918/4078a18b1ebe38cef0d53276cca0561277f52c9f.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone and a belated Happy 2023! It’s normally around this time that we would write a recap of the previous year’s endeavors, and believe me, there were a lot: returning to real-world events, becoming a Twitch Affiliate, and for Mondrian's sequel, Plastic Reality, introducing new game modes, publishing its Free Admission demo, you name it, we did it. But that is not why I’m here today. I am here to talk about pricing.

You have likely seen a lot of news lately about Steam prices being readjusted to match exchange rates, and yes, we will be doing the same, but also striving to be as fair as possible about it. With that in mind, we thought we would give you a heads-up as to the incoming changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10164918/d4cdbde0366fe065e8ada353d5fd795ee288c77d.jpg[/img]

For both [i]Mondrian – Abstraction in Beauty[/i] and [i]Mondrian – Plastic Reality[/i], we will be equalizing prices on Steam across all territories on March 1. Why are we doing this? Well, put simply, the disparity between currencies, as it stands, is staggering. While Plastic Reality is $14.99 USD, it can be purchased for half that amount or less in nearly half of all territories, and also ABOVE retail price in a couple others. For the sake of customers in all territories, we felt it was necessary to balance the pricing across the board. However, before these changes take effect, BOTH GAMES WILL BE ON SALE between February 20 and 27, 34% off for [i]Plastic Reality[/i] and 51% off for [i]Abstraction in Beauty[/i]. This will put [i]Plastic Reality[/i] under $10 for the first time ever! If you have had the games on your Wishlist for a while, make sure to do so now so you don’t miss the upcoming sale. Don't forget that if you already own [i]Abstraction in Beauty[/i], you can upgrade via the Series Bundle for another 30% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1087050/Mondrian__Plastic_Reality/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13469/Mondrian_Series_Bundle/

We realize that even with the discount, the game or bundle may still be too expensive for some. If that is the case, we encourage you to download the Free Admission demo of [i]Plastic Reality[/i] to check out what the sequel has to offer and start getting involved in our welcoming, creative community. We keep the demo up to date too so you will never fall behind on bug fixes or new features!

Some news about the next major update – or “Movement” – for [i]Mondrian – Plastic Reality[/i] will be coming pretty soon. We are attempting to tackle some long-requested changes, so it may take a little while. Stay tuned for that. In the meantime, thank you for your understanding, continued support, and as always, for playing. Here’s to a big 2023!

[i]– Danny[/i]

notes.title: Wishlist Mondrian - Plastic Reality on Steam Today!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! I've got some exciting news for you today. Mondrian's sequel, Plastic Reality, is now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1087050/Mondrian__Plastic_Reality/][b]live on Steam and ready to be Wishlisted[/b][/url]! We are aiming for a release later this year, and we're really excited to show you what we've been cooking up.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1087050/Mondrian__Plastic_Reality/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10164918/80b3ebbdaaf72b226a3606b92c797bb53692870a.jpg[/img][/url]

So you may be wondering, what's so new in this game? It looks pretty much the same! Well, on the surface, you're correct. We've worked hard to perfect the formula we created in Abstraction in Beauty, but under the hood there's so much more going on. It all starts with Mondrian Maker, the game's simple but powerful level editor. Using Mondrian Maker, you can create your own levels in mere seconds, and share them with your friends! We'll be implementing Steam Workshop functionality not just for levels, but also other modifiable content, like background paintings, and even mods themselves. We can't wait to see what you come up with!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10164918/b204ab54c682a5100d0bebeaac48f934c5f97006.gif[/img]

Next, the game itself. There are now five playable characters, each of whom control slightly differently thanks to an improved paddle acceleration system. A new backend "Color Wheel" creates some striking visual results without relying on expensive shaders or alternate versions of assets. In fact, the entire game has been so optimized thanks to smarter coding & an upgrade into Clickteam Fusion 2.5+, that it now only needs ~80mb of RAM to run (for comparison, Abstraction in Beauty needs about 1Gb). We've also introduced loads of new elements like other Obstacles, stackable block Modifiers, and deeper gameplay uses for Gems.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10164918/0aeb93f8a01f22e18252633ec4b027c730fe9e5e.gif[/img]

We're really excited about the way this game is coming out. It builds on the foundation we created back in 2015 and takes it to the stars. We still have loads of work to do for the rest of the year, but everything we're building is turning the game into a highly creative experience.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10164918/d33f5a2e9491b8cffa5831bc6c0d2303409544b5.jpg[/img]

But don't think for one minute that we're going to forget you, the OG fans. There will absolutely be a bundle price, so if you already own [i]Abstraction in Beauty[/i], you'll get [i]Plastic Reality[/i] discounted right from the get-go. It's the least we can do!

We hope you'll support us by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1087050/Mondrian__Plastic_Reality/][b]Wishlisting the game here on Steam.[/b][/url] It only takes a second, and will go a long way toward helping us build the game's community and bringing you an even more exciting product come launch!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9XJBBxMjK7Q
Thank you all so much, thank you for playing, and enjoy the Summer Sale!
[i]- Danny[/i]

notes.title: Surprise Update! Mondrian - Plastic Reality on itch.io
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. I know it's been a long, long while since the last update, and yet here we are. This is an especially exciting update because we have big news. And what is that news?

[url=http://lantanagames.com/mondrian-plastic-reality/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10164918/80b3ebbdaaf72b226a3606b92c797bb53692870a.jpg[/img][/url]
That's right. We are bringing you a new [i]Mondrian[/i] game in 2018! [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] takes what we established in [i]Abstraction in Beauty[/i] and cranks it to 11. Firstly, every bit of art has gotten a MAJOR coat of spitshine, smoothing everything out with an extra, minor layer of baked-in antialiasing to help the overall look. Effects animations have also gotten an overhaul, as well as the powerup icons. There are five playable characters, each with their own, distinct feel thanks to the inclusion of Top Speed, Acceleration, and Braking stats. 99% of game modes & content return from AiB (some minor mechanics may end up getting cut by the end), with tons of brand new levels, and exciting new mechanics like ball types & modifiers (think new kinds of obstacles and ways to vary up ANY kind of block). If you enjoyed [i]Abstraction in Beauty,[/i] you're going to love [i]Plastic Reality.[/i]

https://lantanagames.itch.io/mondrian-plastic-reality

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10164918/bca362417252923807eabeb71466eb913acc9aca.jpg[/img]
But the most important feature of all? [b][i]Mondrian Maker.[/i][/b] You asked for it, you got it. This level editor not only lets you plop blocks down anywhere you'd like in the field-of-play, but for the first time ever, you can rotate/scale any block, use MULTIPLE block shapes per level, and individually set block types & modifiers for each block PER DIFFICULTY. We've rebuilt every level from [i]Abstraction in Beauty[/i] using [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], and are currently in the process of building out new content for [i]Plastic Reality[/i] using the level editor's features to the fullest. Plenty more features will be added in the coming months, including a Campaign builder, improved filetypes, more block types/modifiers, and a whole lot more.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10164918/bec1325d86159f0232ab94eb9585858c30d8b146.jpg[/img]
Now, here's the good news. [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] is available for you to test out right now, including [i]Mondrian Maker[/i]! It is $14.99 USD, [url=https://lantanagames.itch.io/mondrian-plastic-reality] only at itch.io [/url] (for now). However, if you happen to have an itch key for [i]Abstraction in Beauty,[/i], you'll get 30% off! We'll be bringing the same deal to other platforms (like Steam) as we bring the game to them later this year, so if you'd prefer to get in on this deal on Steam, don't worry, we'll have you covered at some point. And yes, we will be including Steam Workshop functionality for you to share your levels (and we're exploring even more options as well, stay tuned!).

https://youtu.be/Eu5VwlPKGlk
We can't wait to show you more [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] this year, so be sure to follow us on Facebook, Instagram, etc. [b]@lantanagames[/b] for the fastest updates. If you're a streamer or content creator, you can request a key on our [url=http://lantanagames.com/content-creators/] Content Creators[/url] page. Also don't forget to check http://lantanagames.com for blog posts (and [i]Children of Liberty[/i] fans: we posted our [url=http://lantanagames.com/children-of-liberty-state-of-the-game-2017-part-1/] first quarterly update for 2018[/url] up there a few weeks ago, don't miss it!).

As of right now, the game is PC only, however we are improving compatibility across the board to attempt a Mac version. Ideally, we go full PC/Mac/Linux, but we can't fully commit to Linux [i]quite[/i] yet. More updates on this as they develop.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10164918/9db3f539475e68c31f38a24d210b850553f72eb7.jpg[/img]
Well, that is all for now, friends! Hope you check out the new game and looking forward to playing some of your levels if you do!

- Danny

notes.title: Happy Birthday, Mondrian! Price Cut & Version 1.3.1 Available Now
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10164918/1429d4f9f8bd96ded7303b18e3c7d67007a9b54a.jpg[/img]

One year ago today, we launched what would become our biggest game to date, but we had no idea just how big. Since then, Mondrian - Abstraction in Beauty has grown beyond anything we imagined when we started the initial prototype, and we 

have our fans to thank for helping us turn the game into a truly great product. There is so much new in this anniversary update, including some long overdue fixes, and we think you're going to love what's in store!

To celebrate, we are dropping the price of the game from $6.99 to $4.99, and the Deluxe Edition from $9.99 to $7.99. If you purchased the game here within the last two weeks and have played for under two hours, feel free to refund and 

pick it up at the reduced price! If you haven't gotten the game yet, this is a great time to pick up Mondrian - Abstraction in Beauty, all 3 game modes, and now all BILLION+ possible levels! Say it with me now: what. a. bargain.

Happy birthday, Mondrian! Thank you all for an amazing year. Have fun!

[i]Features:[/i]
[list][*]Revamped logo!
[*]One new Hexagon and one new Star level for the Plastic pack
[*]Level Layouts are now determined OUTSIDE of the level, during fades from the Main Menu and Gem Chest! Furthermore, level generation has been split into 3-4 events per layout. This means miniscule improvements on load times, but also much greater stability on load and should reduce the chance of the game crashing or hanging when generating a level

notes.title: Version 1.3 Released - Bring Your Quarters [Weeklong Sale - 25% Off!]
notes.notes:
[img]http://lantanagames.com/press/mondrian/images/mainstreet.png[/img]

Prepare, one and all, for Arcade Mode! In this brand new game mode, you'll have 3 lives to get through 20 rounds, collecting gems as you go. If you run out of lives, you can spend 25 gems to restock. However, you're competing for glory on the Steam Leaderboards, so losing that many gems may also mean losing first place! There are separate leaderboards for Relaxing, Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulties, and each difficulty also restocks a different amount of lives for 25 gems (Relaxing & Easy = 3 lives, Medium = 2 lives, Hard = 1 life). Also there is a Steam Achievement for beating Arcade Mode without losing a life. Have fun with that one.

We didn't have time to implement Local Leaderboards yet, but you can expect them at some point within the next couple of minor updates (1.3.1 or 1.3.2).

There are also some other new features, like the Gem Paddle, which expands every time you collect a gem and shrinks the rest of the time; and the Gem Shield, which makes gems bounce against the wall instead of flying through. Also, you asked for Premium Boutique unlocks and you got them. Levels can now be filled with beautiful, Impressionistic background art, which can be unlocked in the Boutique for 250 gems apiece! There are 9 overall, which means you'll need 2250 gems to get every single one (we know this won't be a problem for some of you Gem Hunt connoisseurs). If you're running the game on a lower-end machine, you can reduce the size of backgrounds or turn them off entirely to improve performance.

For anyone playing on an Xbox One Controller, Dualshock 4, or other equally advanced controller on Windows 10, there is now a setting to modify how the game reads trigger states, which will prevent the endless paddle spinning bug. Since the game does not auto-detect your controller (we could but we'd be updating the game until the end of time by detecting new controller names) head into the gameplay options and set the input type to "Advanced Controller." If you don't have a controller plugged in, you don't need to do anything here!

We are also happy to annoucne the release of the Mondrian Shareware Demo! For anyone who has not yet picked up the game, this demo will give you a sense of what the game is all about. It's completely free, though content is greatly limited from the full version. The demo is available here on Steam, as well as on IndieGameStand, itch.io, and we'll be uploading it to other sites as well. We encourage you to share this demo with your friends, family, and even strangers however you'd like.

There's plenty more to check out in this update, so read through the patch list and then jump in and enjoy our favorite build of Mondrian - Abstraction in Beauty to date!

[i]Features:[/i]
[list][*]Backgrounds! Each of our Mondrian-inspired images is available as an in-game background for the Plastic pack, as well as some brand new ones. Each background also has variants to match emulators & color schemes. Backgrounds are available at the premium price of 250 gems apiece
[*]Arcade Mode! In this mode, you have 3 lives to clear 20 levels. If you clear all 20 levels or lose all 3 lives, your score is recorded on the Steam Leaderboard corresponding to your currently selected difficulty!
[*]Gem Paddle! This paddle shrinks while you're not collecting gems, but grows when you do! Unlock it for 48 gems
[*]Gem Shield! This powerup makes gems bounce off the wall for a short time, instead of flying through it. Unlock it for 42 gems
[*]Background Quality Option: Useful for the new backgrounds as well as ones in Benefactor packs, this option allows you to set backgrounds to 100%, 75%, 50%, or 25% resolution. Lower-rez backgrounds can improve performance on lower-end systems
[*]Background Toggle Option: Don't want the backgrounds on at all? No problem! You can toggle backgrounds off entirely, giving the game its classic, minimalist feel throughout. This is also a great option for improving performance as it clears the background from RAM entirely
[*]Added some more tooltips to the Gem Chest screen
[*]Added Controller Type input setup under Gameplay Options. Switching between Normal + Advanced will allow you to set the game to read specific functionality in regards to a controller's triggers. If you do not have a controller attached, this button will be set to a "Don't Worry About This" mode. This is a more in-depth attempt to solve the "Constantly Moving Left" issue with more advanced controllers like the Xbox One controller, which have to do with Z-Axis values as opposed to Z-Rotation values. Advanced Controller mode will read the both the current Z-Axis and Z-Rotation Value, while Normal Controller mode will only read the current Z-Axis Value. If your paddle is spinning uncontrollably, try switching to the Advanced mode.
[*]Added Nightmode overrides for backgrounds
[*]Added super special ending for Arcade Mode!
[*]Six new Steam Achievements to go along with the Gem Paddle, Gem Shield, and Arcade Mode
[*]Added B-Button as Save & Exit control in Options & Boutique[/list]

[i]Changes:[/i]
[*]Improved tap-to-move response time on Main Menu
[*]Added more controller options for exiting the Credits screen
[*]Minor change to lighting functionality in Children of Liberty pack
[*]Increased Font Size of tooltips in Gem Chest screen
[*]Realigned and recentered Boutique
[*]Recentered Gameplay Options
[*]Recentered Special Thanks Credits
[*]Adjusted Difficulty tooltips in Options Menu to include information about Arcade Mode
[*]Increased font size of tooltips on Gem Chest screen
[*]Tied Gem Chest backgrounds into new Background Size system. Gem [*]Chest backgrounds cannot be deactivated. If your Gem Chest is slow (even without a million gems dropping) try dropping the Background Size in the Gameplay Options.
[*]Minor alterations to rate of paddle acceleration
[*]Bombs now have a much greater fading effect in Fading challenges
[*]Updated "Get All Bronze/Silver/Gold" Achievements to reflect the six new achievements. If you previously got these, they will be unaffected[/list]

[i]Bug Fixes:[/i]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where Gem Number popups wouldn't be black & white in Monochrome mode
[*]Fixed a bug where the main menu would scroll too fast while using a controller
[*]Major reorganization of "Erase Data" function. A backend bug fix, but will help stop the engine from crashing when in development
[*]Fixed a bug where new games wouldn't start with 0 gems
[*]Fixed a bug where the Shift key would act as a Select function on the Main Menu
[*]Fixed All Bronze Achievements not unlocking. The game was not searching for the right achievement name when it came to the Play the Tutorial achievement
[*]Fixed a bug where the Main Menu would sometimes automatically scroll up
[*]Fixed a bug where Paddle-less challenges would not set the wall to [*]Follower rotation if Follower was still locked
[*]Override for ball type on Paddle-less challenges
[*]Added a check to prevent particles from inverting in Amber Monochrome and Handheld schemes (may or may not work)
[*]Fixed a bug on the Options screen and Main Menu where the Enter key would be read twice per press
[*]Explored a fix to levels ending before they even begin
[*][b]Hotfix 1: Fixed screen resolution being tied to background activation[/b]
[*][b]Hotfix 2: Fixed paddles blinking in Monochrome color scheme[/b]
[*][b]Hotfix 3: Fixed Gem Shields not deactivating properly[/b]
[*][b]Hotfix 4: Fixed Monochrome color scheme not keeping the level monochrome and causing slowdown[/b]
[*][b]Hotfix 5: Slowed the rate at which pop block particle generators decrement to make sure pop blocks always make particles[/b]
[*][b]Hotfix 6: Fixed the ball having an incredibly small chance of bouncing back into the playing field after leaving[/b]
[*][b]Hotfix 7: Fixed Wildcards not triggering[/b][/list]
Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Mondrian 1.2 Released!
notes.notes:
[img=http://lantanagames.com/press/mondrian/images/destijltree.png]

Hello everyone! This is the biggest update so far in the 1.x era. We've read your feedback in the reviews and made many changes to the game's feel, speed, and features. First and foremost, we've introduced a new gameplay mechanic: Gems! Gems have a chance to spawn when a block gets popped, and will fly out of the arena. Walls don't stop them, so make sure to grab them, because now you unlock all the goodies in the game with the gems you've collected! You can also gain 50 gems instantly just by sharing Mondrian on Facebook and Twitter from the main menu.

On top of the gems, we've completely revamped paddle controls and made them much smoother, with lower initial speed, higher top speed, MUCH greater precision on minor movements, and another acceleration step. You can also now use your controller's bumpers or triggers (a long overdue control scheme) or the A/D keys to move the paddle as well. Ball behavior has also been slightly modified and the size of the Breakerball has been cut in half in an effort to make the game less frustrating at higher difficulties.

This is just a taste of what's new. You'll have to read through the patch notes to see the rest. A big thank you to everyone who supported the game during the recent Holiday Sale and Pay-What-You-Want deal, and a big welcome to all the new players! We also want to thank everybody who stopped by the table at Indie Arcade: Coast to Coast and tried out the update before it went live. We couldn't have made this update this in-depth without your help.

[i]Features:[/i]
[list][*]Gems! Gems have a chance to fly out of a block when popped. Spend gems in the Boutique to unlock paddles, balls, levels, visual effects, and more
[*]Boutique! The Boutique is where you now unlock everything for the game. We'll be building the Boutique out even more in the coming updates
[*]Added Facebook and Twitter share buttons to main menu, as well as +25 gem bonus per share. Buttons are on a 5 minute timer
[*]New gameplay mode: Gem Hunt! Collect gems in the first level, and go Double-Or-Nothing in subsequent levels
[*]A shiny new Gameplay Options screen, which now includes Level Packs and Visual Styles (previously Effect Select), as well as new graphics to demonstrate every option
[*]Remade tutorial and reduced game to just one tutorial, introducing basic movement and mechanics
[*]Added New Gameplay Option: Erase Data. Start fresh with 0 unlocks and 0 gems. Available in the Gameplay Options menu
[*]Added controller bumper buttons, triggers, and keyboard A/D as paddle control varieties
[*]Replaced Progress Check screen with a Gem Chest to show you how many Gems you've collected
[*]Added dedicated sound effect and midscreen animation for Wildcard
[*]Added a Warning before a Challenge Level
[*]Added WASD and Space as controls for Museum
[*]Added Space as control for the Options menu
[*]Four new Piet Mondrian quotes[/list]
[i]Changes:[/i]
[*]Overhauled the way levels are generated
[*]Original gameplay mode now called "Endless," appears when you choose Start Game
[*]Removed all trophies. You now control each Tier's unlocks in the Boutique. Steam Achievements and any unlocks you had are unaffected
[*]Removed the Level Select and Effect Select screens. These are now located in the new Gameplay Options screen
[*]Removed the "Extras" menu
[*]Moved "Send Feedback" and "Get the Lantana Ledger" to the Options menu
[*]Moved "Museum" to the new "Learning" menu, which we plan to fill up with more stuff very soon
[*]Moved Tutorials to the new Start Game menu
[*]Changes are now automatically saved by default upon exiting the Options menu
[*]Color Schemes are now selectable in the Options menu
[*]De Stijl scheme is now unlockable on its own instead of as an end-game reward
[*]Plastic style renamed to Next Gen
[*]Slowed scrolling in menu, but added manual tap-to-scroll to compensate
[*]Tied rate of paddle acceleration and deceleration - not just top speed - to Game Speed setting
[*]Incrased maximum paddle speed by 50% and added extra step of acceleration
[*]Reduced initial speed of paddle and drastically tightened minor paddle movements
[*]Increased ball speed by 12% for all Game Speeds
[*]Reduced the size of the Breakerball by 50%
[*]Simplified paddle movement code
[*]Added a bit more flavor to Achievement icons
[*]Switched Monochrome from a Visual Style to a Color Scheme
[*]Increased chance of wall rotations generating
[*]Increased chance of Breakerball and Speedball generating
[*]Increased chance of Scoop Paddle and Tripaddle generating
[*]Increased Tripaddle side-bounce angle from 45 degrees to 60 degrees.
[*]Increased stereo sound panning
[*]Decreased speed of all automatic wall rotations by 50%
[*]Minor increase on spacing of side detectors for Tripaddle
[*]Metastar is now unlocked at the start of the game
[*]Doubled speed of animation and fade on the big Wall Lock animation
[*]Changed Wildcard icon from Diamond to Swirly
[*]The ball is now always set as the front object, to help make it a bit easier to find among the chaos
[*]Ball and paddle brightness has been limited even further
[*]Extended quote timer by 0.25 seconds
[*]Removed paddle movement sound. Just not feeling it. We'll look into a new one for a future update[/list]
[i]Bug Fixes:[/i][list]
[*]Explored a fix to a bug that would cause the selector on the main menu to not scroll down
[*]Fixed a bug where walls would not rotate in certain challenge modes
[*]Fixed a bug where Opponent wall rotation, if not unlocked, wouldn't reset the rotation type properly
[*]Fixed a bug where hitting a Wildcard powerup would not set the paddle's side detectors to the proper position
[*]Redid controls in Museum for better controller compatibility
[*]Fixed a bug in the Museum where Escape would always go back to the [*]Main Menu, instead of closing a gallery when one is open
[*]Fixed a small bug where gallery controls wouldn't immediately respond upon viewing a gallery
[*]Fixed a big bug where some levels would not read unlock states correctly, causing a loading loop
[*]Fixed a bug where setting Default Options would not set Sound Volume, [*]Music Volume, and Screenshake levels to default values
[*]Fixed a bug that would prevent the game from loading on the very off-hand chance that no levels were activated[/list]

As an aside, if you disliked or were on the fence about the game to begin with, we'd love for you to give it another shot and update your review if you feel like the improvements we've made warrant changing your criticisms. Either way, thank you all so much for the feedback! There will be more updates on the way in the coming weeks/months, so stay tuned.

- Danny

Quick Update: several day-of-update bugs have been squashed, so the game should be good to play now. We've also removed the achievements related to beating the tutorials, as now there is only one tutorial. New achievements related to the gems and other incoming features will be included with 1.3.

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Neverending Nightmares & Children of Liberty Level Packs Released
notes.notes:
[img]http://lantanagames.com/press/mondrian/images/mondrian49.png[/img]

Happy Halloween, everybody! Today, we are excited to bring you the first major update for Mondrian - Abstraction in Beauty, including not one but TWO level packs! The first pack, based on our own Children of Liberty, features 4 layouts (one for each Difficulty setting) and is free for all owners of Mondrian - Abstraction in Beauty. The second, based on Infinitap Games’ Neverending Nightmares, also features 4 layouts, but is available exclusively to owners of both Neverending Nightmares and Mondrian - Abstraction in Beauty on Steam.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/253330/

Some of you may be wondering why we chose to take this route for our DLC, or as we call it, Benefactor Content. The goal of Mondrian - Abstraction in Beauty has always been to help players discover artists, games, and periods in videogame history of which they may never have heard. Rewarding you for trying out some great games is just our small way of thanking you for supporting indie game development. We would also like to extend our thanks to Matt Gilgenbach, Joe Grabowski, Adam Grabowski, and Chris Ewald of Infinitap Games for helping put the pack together. It should be noted that Infinitap Games did not commission Lantana Games to create this level pack, nor are there any deals in place regarding sales, payment, etc. Our work on Benefactor Content is strictly done to help you discover the great work other indie teams are doing, and expand the content in Mondrian - Abstraction in Beauty.

To access the Neverending Nightmares level pack, you must first own Neverending Nightmares on Steam. The pack will then unlock in the Level Select screen, and you may activate or deactivate it at any time. The Neverending Nightmares pack does feature some minor (unanimated) gore. Please note that due to the nature of how the game checks for product ownership, you must be connected to Steam to access the Neverending Nightmares level pack.

As for the Children of Liberty pack, well, it’s free! You don’t even need to own Children of Liberty to play this level pack, as it comes unlocked, nor do you need to be connected to Steam to play it. It’s just extra content for you at no additional charge.

This patch also includes changes based on community feedback. The requirements for several trophies have been cut in half, which should speed up progress through the game.

[i]Features:[/i]
[list][*]Children of Liberty Level Pack added
[*]Neverending Nightmares Level Pack added[/list]

[i]Changes:[/i]
[list][*]"Play 100 Rounds" Trophy/Achievement reduced to "Play 50 Rounds"
[*]"Play 300 Rounds" Trophy/Achievement reduced to "Play 150 Rounds"
[*]"Break 500 Blocks" Trophy/Achievement reduced to "Break 250 Blocks"
[*]"Break 2000 Blocks" Trophy/Achievement reduced to "Break 1000 Blocks"
[*]"Break 5000 Blocks" Trophy/Achievement reduced to "Break 2500 Blocks"
[*]"Detonate 20 Bombs" Trophy/Achievement reduced to "Detonate 10 Bombs"
[*]"Lock the Wall 40 Times" Trophy/Achievement reduced to "Lock the Wall 20 Times"
[*]"Activate 60 Wildcards" Trophy/Achievement reduced to "Activate 30 Wildcards"
[*]Changed ball auto-aim chance to be dependent on Difficulty instead of Game speed, and reduced chance of auto-aim by 50% off blocks and walls.
[*]Activated Children of Liberty and Neverending Nightmares level select options[/list]

[i]Bug Fixes:[/i]
[*]Fixed a bit of mislabeling in the Trophy Case
[*]Fixed Wildcard Trophy text on Progress Check screen
[*]Fixed blocks not always grooving at the right speed in Challenge Levels
[*]Fixed Sound Effects not playing around the beginning of a level, if the Music volume was muted
[*]Fixed a bug where some levels would automatically reactivate after being deactivated in Level Select
[*]Potentially fixed a bug where levels would not fade in when the game was played Windowed.
